related_resources.reason: First-order coupled ODE systems, state-space equations, elimination, and companion matrices.
Eigenvector modes, real and complex eigenvalues, and repeated-root systems.

authorship.scope: Original foundation-first linear systems lecture with non-spoken mathematical companion; 25 earlier manuscripts retained.

prerequisites.reason: First-order integrating factors and initial-value verification.
Damped second-order oscillators and initial position/velocity.

recommended.reason: Optional review of matrix multiplication, eigenvalues and two-dimensional bases.

background: Single-variable differentiation, exponentials and trigonometry; basic two-by-two matrix multiplication and determinants. No PDE, functional analysis, or advanced dynamical systems background.
readiness_checks: Interpret coupled first-order ODEs as a matrix state equation.
Derive the exponential eigenvector modes of a damped spring.
Solve the same triangular system by integrating factors and eigenvectors.

description: Addresses topics from the lecture, including "A state is the information required to start again"; "An eigenvector is a direction that does not turn"; and "A full solution from actual initial data".
